for better or worse.definition: Regardless of whether the outcome is good or bad.

deviate.definition: To depart from an established course or standard.

capture.definition: To take into possession or control by force.

intended.definition: Planned or meant for a specific purpose.

excite.definition: To cause strong feelings of enthusiasm and eagerness in someone.

regurgitate.definition: to repeat information without understanding it.

prescribe.definition: To set down as a rule or recommend a treatment.

available.definition: Ready for use or at hand.

holiday season.definition: The period of celebrations around Christmas and New Year.

drive decision-making.definition: To influence or motivate the process of choosing options.

reward.definition: A thing given in recognition of service, effort, or achievement.

at its heart.definition: The most important or central part of something.

extension.definition: A part added to enlarge or prolong something.

fortunate.definition: Favored by or involving good luck.

morphing.definition: The gradual transformation of one image or object into another.
